Sophie is portrayed as a brilliant scientist driven by a deep sense of altruism. Her primary motivation stems from a personal history, specifically a deadly disease that affected her during her youth, which fuels her tireless dedication to finding a cure. Despite facing significant obstacles, including personal health setbacks and skepticism from her professional peers, she demonstrates remarkable resilience. Her character development highlights her ability to maintain hope and determination even when confronted with overwhelming odds.

Regarding the atmospheric elements mentioned, fluffy things in the sky rain comes from are clouds.
